name: Nicola Francesca
original_name: ニコラ・フランチェスカ
source:
"It's no good to trust me too much, because I'm a bad person. In other words a criminal."

The Number 2 of the Falzone Family. 
A gentle man who looks kind-hearted and barely seems like he's in the Mafia. 
He's a typical Italian man who's used to dealing with women. 
He's [url=/c64020]Dante's[/url] cousin.
Lying comes as easily as breathing to him.
